sections.content: The recovery plan defines R0 through R5 controls for request validation, successor reservation, authorization binding, legacy reuse, refresh, and completion handoff. It requires hash-bound inputs, persisted evidence, fail-closed retries, immutable historical evidence, and rejection of tampered or incomplete chains.
sections.title: Acceptance Requirements

sections.content: Migration tooling materializes fixed RED tests only for R0-R2 and rejects conflicting content. The validator builds deterministic slice snapshots from contract, registry, terminal, authority manifest, candidate files, and repair closure identities.
sections.title: Migration And Validation Tools

sections.content: The terminal validator derives a declared candidate-source manifest, rejects generated, escaped, missing, or colliding paths, validates required receipts and commands, and publishes completion state only after all slices pass. Tests confirm candidate roots are content-sensitive and generated handoff artifacts are excluded.
sections.title: Terminal And Handoff Coverage
